"i) Issue a writ of mandamus directing the Respondent authorities to make available the funds to the respondent No.5 so that the award amount may be released in favour of the petitioners alongwith upto date interest."

Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: After that petitioners have filed Misc. application under section 151 of CPC for seeking direction to respondents to pay remaining award amount to the applicants/petitioners in which petitioners demanded the compound interest as additional acquisition charges @ 12% per annum on market value and also on Solatium.
Petitioners also demanded compound interest @ 15% on the awarded amount.
It is submitted that the entire compensation amount including interest stand disbursed to the petitioners in accordance with the provisions of Act ibid.
There is no provision under section 80 of the Act ibid for payment of compound interest which is demanded by the petitioners.

r It submitted that undersigned has passed award amounting to Rs.3,12,16,478/-
(Three Crore Twelve Lakh Sixteen Thousand Four Hundred Seventy Eight Only).

As per section 80 of the Act ibid interest @ 9% per annum on the awarded amount w.e.f.
24.02.2019 to 23.02.2020 (for one year) amounting to Rs.28,09,483/-
(Twenty Lakh Nine Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Three Only) and thereafter interest @ 15% per annum on the awarded amount w.e.f. 24.02.2020 to 17.07.2023 (1240 days amounting to Rs.1,59,07,575/- (One Crore Fifty Nine Lakh Seven Thousand Five Hundred Seventy Five Only).

Hence, total compensation i.e. awarded amount, interest @ 9% per annum and interest @ 15% per annum total amounting to Rs.4,99,33,536/- has already been disbursed to the petitioners in the month of July 2023 and no amount of compensation is pending of the award dated 23.02.2019."

3. Taking note of the above pleadings of the respondents that entire amount in terms of the award has been disbursed to the petitioners; no amount of compensation is pending due to the petitioners under the award dated 23.02.2019, this writ petition is disposed of, reserving liberty to the petitioners to avail appropriate remedy in accordance with law for redressal of their surviving grievances, if any.
All pending miscellaneous application(s) also stand disposed of.

.
